notes.title: Hotfix and Patch notes: Fixes for crashes and more (Build 16259130)
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Designers,
[/h2]The last 2 weeks were full of work! [b]We're trying to fix crashes and any bugs we notice[/b]. 
Here is the list with some of the recent fixes!

[h2]List of changes
[/h2][list]
[*] Updated links to use the new feedback form for the full game
[*] New Crash Reporter customized for Interior Designer
[*] Localization: Updated the Chinese translation for "Clear background behind the chair" so that it's less confusing
[*] Bugfix: Crash when deleting all the walls of a 3-way joint, when the roof is enabled
[*] Bugfix: Crash occurred if deleting a wall after its left and right neighbor walls have already been removed
[*] Bugfix: Importing a FBX model file would cause a crash
[*] Bugfix: When creating a new room over an existing staircase using the Create Room drag-drop tool, a cutout for the stairs in the floor would not be created
[*] Bugfix: Color and Material Picker was not restoring the original selection mode after picking
[*] Bugfix: After adding a new wall to connect 2 existing wall corners, undoing the action will leave cuts at the corners
[*] Bugfix: Creating a new room on an upper floor using the drag-drop tool will result in a room with a ceiling that is twice as tall
[*] Bugfix: On an upper floor, adding a wall and enclosing a new room will result in the new room's floor being set to ground level
[*] Bugfix: When creating a new wall connected to an existing wall, canceling the action would leave a cut in the existing wall
[/list]

We hope you will be able to enjoy the game even more now!

Best regards,
Interior Designer team

notes.title: Powerful design tools of Interior Designer
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Designers![/h2]

Let’s dive into the powerful tools that will [b]elevate your creativity in Interior Designer[/b]! 

[h2]What's so special about Interior Designer?[/h2]
Here’s a breakdown of the special tools you'll be using:

[h3]Modular Furniture System
[/h3]
Mix and match pieces to craft unique furniture that perfectly suits your spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/56bc76e33a346b479a01db4fd408ff81a33e699c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Adjustable Shelving
[/h3]
Customize shelves by adjusting their height, width, and position to fit any room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/179df5d5cba01e4c2b0ecec32c98f1c3766013aa.jpg[/img]

[h3]Room Layout Planner
[/h3]
Quickly outline and organize rooms using easy-to-use grid-based planning tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/d857f37abff31fefe4c09a90dd539c6f0016a949.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dynamic Lighting Setup
[/h3]
Create mood and ambiance with customizable lighting fixtures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/6020f535222f487ff11d0114719bb24d0bfd295d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Add Interior Designer to your wishlist now![/h2]
Play the Interior Designer's demo (yes, it's still available!), share your gameplay on YouTube, and [b]add the game to your wishlist! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

[h2]And join us on Discord![/h2]
If you want to [b]ask the developer questions or simply share your artwork,[/b] join our Discord and talk about the game with the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/6axhxV6XbE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Your design adventure will start in just 2 days![/h2]
The Interior Designer Team

notes.title: NEW Interior Designer DEMO is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Designers!
[/h2]
We’ve got some exciting news for all of you who can’t wait to start creating! [b]You can now try out a NEW demo of Interior Designer on Steam[/b]. This is your chance to step into the world of interior design and get hands-on with the tools that will help you craft stunning spaces.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928510/Interior_Designer_Demo/

[h2]Get a sneak peek into the full game[/h2]
The demo offers a preview of the core gameplay features,[b] including a selection of furniture, materials, and decor items that will be available in the full release[/b]. You’ll have access to a sample project where you can experiment with room layouts, color palettes, and unique design styles. Whether you're drawn to modern, minimalist vibes or a more vintage charm, there’s something for every type of designer in this demo.

[h2]Feedback is key!
[/h2]We want to hear from you! While you’re testing out the demo, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and feedback with us via the Steam Community Hub or Steam reviews for the demo app. Your feedback will help us fine-tune the game and make it even better for the full release on October 25th.

[h2]Add Interior Designer to your wishlist now![/h2]
Play the Interior Designer's demo (yes, it's still available!), share your gameplay on YouTube, and [b]add the game to your wishlist! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

[h2]And join us on Discord![/h2]
If you want to [b]ask the developer questions or simply share your artwork,[/b] join our Discord and talk about the game with the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/6axhxV6XbE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img][/url]

Happy Designing! We can’t wait to see your creations and hear your feedback!
Interior Designer team

notes.title: UI improvements and a new trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Designers,[/h2]
We've entered the release month! It is so exciting for us to read your opinions on the demo and see that you are excited to play the game soon! 

[h2]What's going on with the game at the moment?[/h2]

[h3]UI improvements and bug fixing[/h3]
The developer of the game (yes, it is created by only one developer + managed by a small publishing and QA team) is working on[b] improving the UI of the game and making it clearer and more elegant[/b]. We hope you will appreciate it as much as we do!

We are also working hard on finding and eliminating any bugs to create a pleasurable experience of designing realistic interiors. 

[h3]Trailer[/h3]
There is also [b]a release trailer in the making[/b], thanks to our collaboration with DashDot company. I can already tell you it looks amazing, and I can't wait for you to see it! 

[h3]YouTube and Twitch[/h3]
In the past weeks, you could see the game on [b]Twitch and YouTube as various creators covered it on their channels[/b]. If you're interested in a deeper look at the gameplay, make sure to search for the content on the game on both platforms.

[previewyoutube=ixk211I1-g8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ixk211I1-g8&t=394s&pp=ygUaaW50ZXJpb3IgZGVzaWduZXIgZ2FtZXBsYXk%3D[/previewyoutube]

[h3]New demo is almost here[/h3]
We improved the demo, and [b]plan to update it to Steam this week. [/b]Make sure to not miss it!

[h2]Review the demo now![/h2]
We would be [b]extremely grateful if you could review the demo and leave your feedback[/b] on the game there. We still want to know what you like about it, and what could use some improvements. At this point, I can't promise that we will address it before the release, but we will make sure to analyze each piece of feedback with utmost care. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928510/Interior_Designer_Demo/

[h2]And join us on Discord![/h2]
If you want to [b]ask the developer questions or simply share your artwork,[/b] join our Discord and talk about the game with the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/6axhxV6XbE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img][/url]

Best regards,
Interior Designer team

notes.title: What you need to know about the Sandbox Mode in Interior Designer?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Designers![/h2]

We are thrilled to give you more details about [b]the Sandbox Mode in Interior Designer! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/566d690c018ade48c4dd7afbbdb927d375a566d6.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is the Sandbox Mode?[/h2]

This feature allows you to [b]unleash your creativity without any limitations[/b]. Whether you're dreaming of designing cozy bedrooms, sleek gaming rooms, luxurious bathrooms, or state-of-the-art home gyms, Sandbox Mode provides a blank canvas for you to experiment and [b]bring your vision to life[/b].

In Sandbox Mode, you can access a vast catalog of furniture, decor, and architectural elements. [b]Some of them will be accessible only by playing through the Career Mode first[/b] and gathering Star Points which will allow you to unlock more and more furniture along the way. 

Play around with different layouts, colors, and styles to create spaces that truly reflect your unique taste. [b]The intuitive design tools[/b] at your fingertips make it easy to adjust lighting, customize furniture, and manipulate every aspect of your interiors effortlessly.

What's more, Sandbox Mode is not just about creating beautiful spaces - it's also a fantastic way to improve your design skills. [b]With no client demands, you can take your time to perfect your designs[/b], try out new ideas, and explore endless possibilities.

[h2]Sign up for the closed alpha and beta tests![/h2]
We have launched [b]sign-ups for closed playtests of Interior Designer![/b] And we're still looking for more and more players! Make sure to fill out [url=https://forms.gle/9hoizTuomDBG24Tp9]this form[/url] to sign up and await our e-mail in a couple of weeks.

notes.title: Interior Designer Demo is live!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Designers,
[/h2]We're excited to announce that [b]Interior Designer is participating in the June edition of Steam Next Fest 2024[/b]. The demo was released on June 3rd and will remain available for you until June 10th at least (maybe a bit longer).

[previewyoutube=lIrYYqzoDVk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What can you expect?
[/h2]In our demo, [b]you will find the career mode with five quests and a brief tutorial [/b]on how to use various buttons and features. Therefore, we recommend playing it first, so you can learn how to move around the game.
Then,[b] head up to the sandbox mode[/b]. There, you can try to design a living room or a bedroom, plan your future interiors, and create a general layout of a house. 
Still, [b]the demo offers you a limited selection of furniture[/b]. In the full game, we will have about 900-1000 pieces of furniture available on the release day, and even more afterwards. We plan to offer various options for each type of room, starting with a bedroom and living room, and finishing with a bathroom, kitchen, and hall.

[h2]We care for your feedback!
[/h2]At the end of the demo, you will find an option to [b]share your feedback on the game with us[/b]. Please, give us 10 minutes to do it, because we want to hear what works well in the game in your opinion, and what should be improved or completely changed.

[h2]And add it to your wishlist!
[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

[h2]And join our Discord![/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/RFuhEwWqFb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img]
[/url]

That's all for today!
[b]Remember: design is not a thing you do - it's a way of life!
[/b]
Interior Designer team
